title: Late nineties 3D Hack and Slash
author: Nixi999
selftext:
Hey guys!

I would like to hear your opinions on my game demo. The video contains real gameplay; it was just specially directed for the trailer to look a bit more epic-ish.

It is really something that my 9-year-old self would have liked a lot at the beginning of the 2000s.

I asked my friend/colleague about this, and he said, "Cool, but nobody cares about this style anymore."

So tell me, guys, if you like it or not. If we get some reactions or comments here, I might consider continuing the development. If nobody likes it, I won't put more time and effort into it. For me, game-making is about building a community around something. That's what keeps me motivated!
